ask: can u make a checklist of everything we decided so far and who suggested each
sentence: A shared checklist of group decisions where each item shows who suggested it, anyone can tick items off or add new ones, and a progress bar shows how many are done.
use_when: The group wants a list of what has been decided so far, with who proposed each item
People need to tick off plans or tasks as they get done
Anyone in the chat should be able to add an item or remove one they suggested
Wrapping up trip or event planning into one summary list
dont_use_when: The group needs to vote between options before deciding
Costs need to be split or tracked between people
Tasks must be assigned to specific people with due dates
